summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have centered on enhancing performance and functionality, including proposals for fine-grained access policies and improved metadata handling in the REST Catalog. Additionally, there is a strong focus on optimizing CI processes and addressing ambiguities in specifications.
highlights: Integration efforts and discussions related to Spark
Proposal to refactor OSSFileIO for performance improvements
Implementation of read API for table and column labels in REST Catalog
Proposals for optimizing CI runner times and clarifying Avro schema
